device_entry.description: 一种基于 FTDI 芯片的 USB 数字 I/O 接口器件，可在位操作模式下将 8 条引脚配置为输入或输出，并读取或驱动数字电平。实验室中常用于简单数字电路、继电器、触发线或自定义仪器接口的低速控制与状态采集。
device_entry.description_en: A USB digital I/O interface based on an FTDI chip, operating in bit-bang mode to configure 8 pins as inputs or outputs and to read or drive digital logic levels. In laboratories it is commonly used for low-speed control and status acquisition with simple digital circuits, relays, trigger lines, or custom instrument interfaces.
